fields.name: container
fields.coerce: none: used as a key of `player.slots`
fields.description: The equipment slot of the container that gets the pet.

fields.name: pet
fields.coerce: none: used as a key of `player.slots`
fields.description: The equipment slot of the container that the server removes.

responses.name: Success
responses.when: The merge is done. The payload is a bare string.

failures.intro: Every failure is the bare string `"merge_mismatch"`.

rows.when: A slot is empty, or the item in it has no `type: "container"`. The check reads `type` on the item in the slot, not on `G.items`.
The `grade` of the receiving container is lower than the grade of the other one, or the receiving container has `data` already.

also.summary: Your state with `reopen: true`. The `pet` slot is empty.
